subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence staging, rolling ingest & retention request
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@finedge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@procure.finedge.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — evidence window & retention update

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming SOC 2 renewal. A couple of items we need to confirm from Redwood before we can start scheduling our internal audit:

- Retention horizon: can Redwood commit to 730 days for audit logs and CloudTrail snapshots? Our compliance team prefers a 2-year window for historical traceability.
- Evidence staging: we have ~1.2TB of logs and supporting artifacts. Would Redwood accept a phased weekly ingest to a temporary staging S3 / secure transfer location?
- Access controls: we need read-only access and an auditable account for our auditors (no write/delete).
- Legal: I’ll loop in Gina (legal) — we may need a short DPA addendum for the extended retention and staging access.

Can you share a proposed schedule and any templates you want us to follow for evidence uploads? Also tell us if there will be any changes to the renewal pricing if we increase retention and request burst capacity for the ingestion period.

Appreciate a quick runbook so we can plan our audit window (target: December 2026).

Best,
Alicia Torres
Head of Compliance
FinEdge Analytics

---
Alicia Torres
Head of Compliance | FinEdge Analytics
+1 415-555-0192

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@finedge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — evidence window & retention update

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear summary. We can support the request; below is a proposed approach that balances operational load and your December audit target.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Retention: commit to 730 days for CloudTrail and platform audit logs. We will update the DPA addendum in parallel; legal (Laura) is copied.
2) Evidence staging: set up a dedicated, read-only S3 staging bucket in us-west-2 with strict bucket policy. We recommend a phased weekly ingest: 150–250GB/week to keep parity with our ingestion pipelines and to avoid throttling. Final bulk window available the week prior to your audit if needed.
3) Access: we’ll provide an auditable, role-based read-only IAM role scoped to the staging prefix. Access is logged via CloudTrail and forwarded to a retention bucket with 730d lifecycle.
4) Burst capacity: for the scheduled ingest weeks we can provision +50% ingestion throughput (one-time uplift) at a short-term pricing adjustment — I’ll have Sales/Finance confirm.
5) Onboarding artifacts: attached is a filled evidence upload template (rwi_evidence_upload_template.xlsx) and snapshot instructions (snapshot_instructions.pdf). We also created a short runbook (soc2_ingest_runbook_v1.md) describing the flow.

Milestones / dates (requested):
- Nov 5: Legal DPA addendum draft (Laura)
- Nov 9: Staging bucket & IAM role provisioned
- Nov 9–Dec 7: Weekly phased ingest windows (you choose day of week; earlier the better)
- Dec 14: Final bulk snapshot and audit window (target)

Action items for FinEdge: confirm preferred day for weekly ingest, and share an initial inventory export by Nov 8 so we can validate prefixes and sizing.

I’ll follow up with Ben (ops) and Jonas (runtime) to coordinate the staging creds and short-term throughput increase.

Thanks — speak soon.

Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Ops prep for FinEdge staging (S3 + creds)

Kim / Jonas — tagging this thread for ops work. Points to cover:
- Provision dedicated S3 staging bucket: rwi-finedge-staging-4732 (us-west-2), enforced server-side encryption, MFA delete disabled for staging but retention lifecycle applied on forward-to-archive bucket.
- Create read-only IAM role: arn:aws:iam::...:role/rwi-finedge-readonly-4732
- Generate short-lived credentials for FinEdge engineers (we'll provide an s3-temp-creds.txt stub; actual creds to be delivered via our secrets channel).
- Ensure CloudTrail events for downloads are shipped to rwi-archive-logs with 730d lifecycle; enable object-level logging for the staging prefix.

Attachment: s3-temp-creds.txt (STUB – creds will expire in 24h when generated)

Jonas — can you confirm the throughput uplift plan? I estimate +50% for the weeks Nov 9, Nov 16, Nov 23, Nov 30. If FinEdge needs the final bulk week we can provision an additional short window.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer

From: Alicia Torres <alicia@finedge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@procure.finedge.com>, Gina Park <gina.park@finedge.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — evidence window & retention update

Kimberly — this looks good, couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Access control: the read-only role is fine. One requirement: auditors must assume/read into the role via SAML or cross-account role chaining (they cannot use root creds). Can you confirm the role supports external SAML principals?
- Auditability: we need an export of access events (who assumed the role and what objects were downloaded) in CSV format for our evidence binder. Is that possible on a weekly cadence?
- Pricing/Purchasing: Tom (cc'd) will review the uplift pricing. We also need the DocuSign flow for any DPA addendum so procurement can route it immediately.

Attached: Finedge-DPA-request.pdf (legal asks and suggested language on retention)

If you can confirm SAML support and weekly CSV access reports, we can lock in Nov 9 for the first ingest (preferred day: Tuesdays).

Thanks,
Alicia

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — evidence window & retention update

Hi Alicia / Tom — Laura on Legal. A couple notes on the DPA request and procurement flow:

- DPA addendum: we can accept the requested 730d retention; I'll draft a short addendum that references the staging bucket and the audit access model (read-only role + CloudTrail exports). Expect the first draft by Friday Nov 5.
- DocuSign: once both parties agree on the addendum I'll route it via DocuSign. Please confirm the signing authority (Tom, Procurement) and email for routing.
- PO & billing: any short-term throughput uplift (the +50% ingestion windows) will be billed as a one-time usage uplift; Finance will produce an interim invoice. If you prefer a committed seat/seat uplift, we can propose a 12-month seat addendum but that's optional.

Action: Tom, please share the procurement contact for DocuSign and confirm whether FinEdge will approve the interim usage invoice or needs consolidated renewal billing.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@finedge.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@procure.finedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — evidence window & retention update

Alicia / Tom — confirming next steps and commitments so everyone is aligned: 

1) Access & auditability
   - We will create a cross-account SAML-enabled read-only role that auditors can assume. Role will be limited to the staging prefix; access attempts will be logged and an access-events CSV will be exported weekly to your shared drive folder (see related links).
2) Retention
   - Redwood commits to 730-day retention for CloudTrail and platform audit logs. We'll add the clause to the DPA addendum (Laura to draft by Nov 5).
3) Schedule (confirmed)
   - Nov 9 (Tuesday): staging bucket provisioned & initial credential handoff; first weekly ingest window.
   - Nov 9–Dec 7: weekly Tuesday ingest windows, target 150–250GB/week.
   - Dec 14: optional final bulk snapshot window if needed.
4) Throughput / pricing
   - Ops (Jonas/Ben) to provision +50% ingestion throughput during the scheduled weeks. Any short-term uplift consumption will appear as an interim usage line item; Tom, please advise if you want a consolidated invoice.
5) Legal / procurement
   - Laura will send DPA addendum draft Nov 5 and route via DocuSign once agreed. DocuSign link will be provided (placeholder in related links).

Attachments for this thread: rwi_evidence_upload_template.xlsx, snapshot_instructions.pdf, soc2_ingest_runbook_v1.md (all attached earlier).

If this matches FinEdge's needs, Alicia please confirm "Tuesdays OK" and Tom confirm the procurement routing preference so we can lock dates.

Thanks all — we’ll generate the staging credentials and an ops checklist post-send.

Kind regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
